name: aerosignal-native
description: AeroSignal iOS and Android apps (Capacitor shell around the web app in ../dist)

scripts.web: cd .. && node build.mjs && rm -rf native/www && cp -r dist native/www
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
